card.name: Rates stated per number of patients
card.fires_on: The last digit or unit word in a stated risk rate, such as 'per 250,000', 'for every 530 patients' or 'per million', just before the word treated or treatment.

modes.label: End of a rate figure
modes.description: The final digit of a large number in a per-population risk rate.

modes.label: Population word after per
modes.description: A word like patients or million that closes a 'per N' or 'for every N' phrase.
